topics.label: Mandatory invoice fields

topics.label: Rounding difference tolerance

topics.label: Supplier behavioural patterns

attributes.label: IRN mandatory turnover threshold
attributes.description: Supplier annual turnover above which IRN is mandatory. Changed from ₹10 crore to ₹5 crore in August 2023.

attributes.label: IRN and QR code mandatory fields
attributes.description: Fields required on invoice when IRN applies.

attributes.label: E-invoicing effective date
attributes.description: Date from which e-invoicing mandate applies.

attributes.label: General price tolerance percentage
attributes.description: Percentage tolerance applied per line under SOP v4.0 (lower of this percentage and the cap amount).

attributes.label: General price tolerance cap amount
attributes.description: Maximum rupee amount tolerance per line under SOP v4.0 (lower of percentage and this cap).

attributes.label: Infra cement and steel price tolerance percentage
attributes.description: Special 10% price tolerance for cement and steel in Infra projects per FAQ.

attributes.label: Price variance percentage threshold
attributes.description: Price variance percentage threshold (e.g., 1.5%) above which PRICE_VAR is raised.

attributes.label: Price variance absolute threshold
attributes.description: Absolute monetary threshold (e.g., ₹1,000) above which PRICE_VAR is raised.

attributes.label: Infra material quantity tolerance percentage
attributes.description: Allowed invoice quantity excess over GRN quantity for cement, reinforcement steel, sand, aggregates (5%).

attributes.label: Infra material quantity tolerance value cap
attributes.description: Maximum excess value allowed on invoice for the quantity tolerance (₹25,000).

attributes.label: Materials eligible for Infra quantity tolerance
attributes.description: List of materials to which the 5%/₹25k quantity tolerance applies.

attributes.label: General quantity tolerance percentage
attributes.description: Allowed percentage tolerance for invoice quantity over GRN quantity (e.g., 2%).

attributes.label: Quantity tolerance applicability
attributes.description: Whether quantity tolerance applies to all goods or only specific materials.

attributes.label: Materials requiring QA release before payment
attributes.description: Material types that must have batch status Released in QMS: APIs, excipients, primary packaging material.

attributes.label: Required QMS batch status
attributes.description: Batch status that allows payment: Released. Quarantine or Rejected blocks payment.

attributes.label: Payment block until QA release
attributes.description: Whether payment is blocked until batch release (true). Invoice may be posted but payment block stays.

attributes.label: Non-PO allowed categories
attributes.description: Categories that can be processed without a PO: courier, store rent, marketing agency (with campaign ID).

attributes.label: Store rent invoice mandatory fields
attributes.description: Fields that must appear on store rent invoices: store code and lease agreement number.

attributes.label: Marketing agency invoice requires approved campaign ID
attributes.description: Marketing agency invoices must quote an approved campaign ID; otherwise held as NON_PO_NOT_ALLOWED.

attributes.label: Payment run day
attributes.description: Day of week when payment run occurs.

attributes.label: Submission cutoff day
attributes.description: Day by which invoices must be submitted for the payment run.

attributes.label: Submission cutoff time
attributes.description: Time on cutoff day by which invoices must be submitted (5 pm).

attributes.label: MSME maximum payment days with agreement
attributes.description: Maximum days to pay MSME suppliers when written agreement exists (45).

attributes.label: MSME maximum payment days without agreement
attributes.description: Maximum days to pay MSME suppliers when no written agreement (15).

attributes.label: GSTIN active status check required
attributes.description: Confirm GSTIN status shows green tick (active on invoice date).

attributes.label: Action when GSTIN cancelled
attributes.description: What happens if supplier GSTIN is cancelled on invoice date.

attributes.label: E-invoicing turnover threshold
attributes.description: Supplier turnover above which e-invoice with IRN is mandatory.

attributes.label: E-invoicing effective date
attributes.description: Date from which e-invoicing mandate applies.

attributes.label: GST return form for ITC check
attributes.description: Form used to verify Input Tax Credit: GSTR-2B (changed from GSTR-2A).

attributes.label: ITC form available date
attributes.description: Day of month when GSTR-2B becomes available (14th, changed from 20th).

attributes.label: Action when invoice missing from GSTR-2B
attributes.description: What to do if invoice not reflected in GSTR-2B.

attributes.label: Buyer GSTIN mismatch exception code
attributes.description: Exception code raised when buyer GSTIN does not match.

attributes.label: Buyer GSTIN mismatch action
attributes.description: Action taken on buyer GSTIN mismatch.

attributes.label: Required documents for bank change request
attributes.description: Documents that must accompany request: letterhead, signed, cancelled cheque for new account.

attributes.label: Verification call mandatory

attributes.label: Call only vendor master phone number
attributes.description: If request gives a different phone number or asks to call someone else, do not call it; log as suspicious.

attributes.label: Approval chain for bank change
attributes.description: Sequence of approvers: Vendor Master lead then AP Controller.

attributes.label: Payment block duration after approval
attributes.description: ERP blocks payments to new account for this many hours after second approval (24).

attributes.label: Bank change freeze period before month-end

attributes.label: Approver role for high-value invoices
attributes.description: Role that must approve invoices above threshold: AP Controller.

attributes.label: Auto-park approval threshold
attributes.description: Invoice amount above which system parks automatically for AP Controller approval (₹10 lakh per DI-03).

attributes.label: Client CFO approval threshold
attributes.description: Invoice amount above which client CFO approval required.

attributes.label: Invoice retention years
attributes.description: Number of years invoices must be kept (8).

attributes.label: Supplier bank details sharing restricted
attributes.description: Supplier bank details must not be shared outside the AP team.

attributes.label: TDS rate when no valid PAN

attributes.label: AMC classification rule

attributes.label: Action when TDS section unclear
attributes.description: What to do when TDS section cannot be determined.

attributes.label: Legal fees subject to reverse charge

attributes.description: How the system normalises invoice numbers for duplicate detection.

attributes.label: Action on duplicate check amber flag

attributes.label: DUP_SUSPECT resolution target
attributes.description: Target resolution time for possible duplicate exception.

attributes.label: GRN posting deadline (working days)
attributes.description: Requesters should post GRNs within this many working days of receipt (2).

attributes.label: Posting cutoff rule
attributes.description: Invoices received up to the second-last working day of the month are posted in that month; after third-last working day are accrued.

attributes.label: Accrue uninvoiced GRNs
attributes.description: GRNs not invoiced are accrued at month-end.

attributes.label: Exception review required
attributes.description: Team Lead reviews open exceptions before month-end close.

attributes.label: MSME payment days
attributes.description: Number of days within which an accepted MSME supplier invoice must be paid (60 days).

attributes.label: Escalation trigger days before due date
attributes.description: If MSME invoice is within this many days of due date and still stuck, escalate (7).

attributes.label: Escalation recipient
attributes.description: Role/person to notify: senior processor (Sandeep).

attributes.label: Chase QRMP supplier in month 1 or 2 of quarter
attributes.description: Whether to chase quarterly filer for missing invoices in first two months of quarter (false).

attributes.label: Hold GST for QRMP supplier mismatches
attributes.description: Pay base amount, hold GST, but do not chase quarterly filer until quarter-end.

attributes.label: Legal fees always under reverse charge
attributes.description: Legal fees from advocates are always RCM; invoice will not show GST.

attributes.label: DUP_SUSPECT resolution target

attributes.description: Target resolution time for Pharma QA release pending exception.

attributes.label: AATO band from which IRN is required

attributes.label: Invoice intake channels
attributes.description: Ways invoices can arrive.

attributes.label: List of mandatory invoice fields
attributes.description: Fields that must appear on every invoice.

attributes.label: Maximum accepted rounding difference

attributes.label: Known supplier resend suffixes
attributes.description: Suffixes suppliers add when resending same invoice.

attributes.label: Pharma packaging supplier early invoicing lead
attributes.description: Days before dispatch that Pharma packaging supplier invoices.

attributes.label: Infra GRN batching day
attributes.description: Day when Infra sites batch their GRNs.

attributes.label: Infra GRN batching cut-off
attributes.description: When to wait for Infra GRN batching to complete.

attributes.label: AP Controller approves payment proposals
attributes.description: Whether AP Controller approves payment proposals

attributes.label: AP Controller maximum approval amount
attributes.description: Maximum invoice amount AP Controller can approve

attributes.label: AP Processor responsibilities
attributes.description: List of responsibilities for AP Processor

attributes.label: Applicable clients
attributes.description: Clients to which the SOP applies

attributes.label: Applicable roles
attributes.description: Roles to which the SOP applies

attributes.label: Approval count for bank account changes
attributes.description: Number of approvals required for bank account changes

attributes.label: Buyer GSTIN place of supply rule
synonyms: buyer gstin place of supply rule
attributes.description: Rule for buyer GSTIN based on place of supply

attributes.label: Buyer GSTIN state check
attributes.description: Buyer GSTIN must be correct for state of delivery

attributes.label: Call recording details for change ticket
attributes.description: Verification call details that must be recorded in change ticket

attributes.label: Check batch number on GRN against QMS
synonyms: check batch number on grn against qms
attributes.description: For Arvana Pharma, batch number on GRN must be checked against Quality Management System

attributes.label: Check QRMP before chase
attributes.description: Check whether supplier is quarterly filer under QRMP before chasing for GSTR-2B mismatches

attributes.label: Check TDS section against service nature
synonyms: check tds section against service nature
attributes.description: User must check vendor master's suggested TDS section against nature of service on invoice

attributes.label: Client memo precedence
attributes.description: Client memo in desk instructions takes precedence over SOP for that client

attributes.label: Courier and travel agency require PO
attributes.description: Courier and travel agency invoices require a purchase order and are not allowed as non-PO categories

attributes.label: Apply credit note against original invoice
synonyms: credit note apply against original invoice
attributes.description: Credit note should be applied against the original invoice

attributes.label: If paid set off against next invoice and record link
synonyms: credit note if paid setoff against next invoice and record link
attributes.description: If original invoice is paid, set off credit note against next invoice from same supplier and record link

attributes.label: Credit note must quote original invoice number and date
synonyms: credit note must quote original invoice number and date
attributes.description: A credit note must quote the original invoice number and date

attributes.label: Debit note approved by requester
attributes.description: Debit notes must be approved by the requester

attributes.label: Debit note issued within days of GRN rejection
synonyms: debit note issued within seven days of grn rejection
attributes.description: Debit notes must be issued within seven days of GRN rejection

attributes.label: Debit note raised for short supply or rejected material
synonyms: debit note raised for short supply or rejected material
attributes.description: Debit notes are raised by the client for short supply or rejected material

attributes.label: Default payment terms days
attributes.description: Default payment terms for non-MSME suppliers are 60 days from invoice acceptance unless PO states otherwise

attributes.label: Do not ask IT to lift block
synonyms: do not ask it to lift block
attributes.description: Do not ask IT to lift the payment block on the new bank account

attributes.label: Do not correct supplier invoices by hand
synonyms: do not correct supplier invoices by hand
attributes.description: Supplier invoices must not be corrected by hand

attributes.label: Do not pay base value for missing IRN
synonyms: do not pay base value for missing irn
attributes.description: Base value of invoice missing IRN must not be paid; a valid invoice will follow

attributes.label: DUP_SUSPECT routing rule
attributes.description: DUP_SUSPECT exceptions must always be routed to a Senior Processor regardless of processor's judgment.

attributes.label: Duplicate check lookback window
attributes.description: Duplicate checks compare each invoice against invoices received in the last 18 months for the same supplier.

attributes.label: Duplicate match criteria
attributes.description: Two invoices are flagged as suspected duplicates if either the supplier GSTIN and normalised invoice number match, or the supplier, invoice date, and total amount (within ₹1) match.

attributes.label: New bank account effective from next payment run
attributes.description: The new bank account may be used from the next payment run.

attributes.label: Email confirmation required for bank account change
attributes.description: Bank account changes are accepted only when the supplier confirms the change by email from the email address registered in the vendor master.

attributes.label: Email invoice processing description
attributes.description: Email invoices are processed by an intake bot that sends PDF and image attachments to OCR.

attributes.label: Default exception resolution target
attributes.description: Target resolution for all exception codes is five working days.

attributes.label: NO_GRN exception owner
attributes.description: The owner responsible for resolving NO_GRN exceptions is the Requester.

attributes.label: NO_GRN exception resolution target
synonyms: exception handling no grn target days
attributes.description: The target resolution time for NO_GRN exceptions is 5 working days.

attributes.label: NOT_IN_2B exception meaning
attributes.description: The exception NOT_IN_2B means an invoice missing from GSTR-2B after two further cycles.

attributes.label: NOT_IN_2B exception owner
attributes.description: The owner of the NOT_IN_2B exception is the Vendor owner.

attributes.label: NOT_IN_2B exception resolution target
attributes.description: The target to resolve the NOT_IN_2B exception is the next cycle.

attributes.label: Every exception has code and owner
attributes.description: Every exception is assigned a code and an owner.

attributes.label: Exception note requirement
attributes.description: When parking an invoice with an exception, the user must add a one-line note that a stranger could understand.

attributes.label: Exception owner assignment source
attributes.description: Each exception is assigned to the owner shown in the AP tracker.

attributes.label: Processor role in exception routing
attributes.description: The processor's job is to route the exception to the correct owner with an actionable note, not to fix the purchase order themselves.

attributes.label: MSME_DUE exception resolution target
attributes.description: The target resolution for exception code MSME_DUE is before due date.

attributes.label: First step in invoice processing is duplicate check
attributes.description: The first step in invoice processing is the duplicate check.

attributes.label: Bank account changes high fraud risk
attributes.description: Bank account changes are considered a high fraud risk area.

attributes.label: Default payment terms for non-MSM suppliers
attributes.description: Other suppliers are paid on 60-day terms unless the PO specifies otherwise.

attributes.label: Goods invoice requires GRN before posting
synonyms: goods invoice requires grn before posting
attributes.description: A goods invoice must not be posted against a purchase order without a GRN, regardless of requester's verbal instruction.

attributes.label: Action when GRN missing for goods invoice
attributes.description: A goods invoice without a GRN is held and the requester is e-mailed. The system automatically notifies the requester when a goods invoice has no GRN.

attributes.label: GST tab confirmation requirements
attributes.description: Buyer GSTIN must be confirmed on the GST tab. Tax type must be confirmed on the GST tab.

attributes.label: GSTIN_INACTIVE exception resolution target
attributes.description: The target resolution time for exception GSTIN_INACTIVE is 2 working days.

attributes.label: Return code for incomplete invoice
attributes.description: If an invoice is missing any mandatory field, it is returned to the supplier with code INV_INCOMPLETE.

attributes.label: Exception clearance authority for invoices up to 10 lakh
synonyms: invoice approval authority exceptions cleared by senior processor
attributes.description: Exceptions for invoices up to ₹10 lakh are cleared by a Senior Processor.

attributes.label: No approval needed for invoices up to 10 lakh
synonyms: invoice approval authority no approval below 10 lakh
attributes.description: For invoices up to ₹10 lakh, no approval is needed beyond a clean match.

attributes.label: Non-PO invoices require budget owner approval
synonyms: invoice approval authority non po requires budget owner
attributes.description: Any non-PO invoice requires budget owner approval in addition to the applicable threshold approvals.

attributes.label: Quantity must not exceed GRN
attributes.description: Invoice quantity must not exceed the GRN quantity.

attributes.label: Invoice verification step
attributes.description: The processor opens the invoice from the work queue in the ERP Invoice Verification screen and verifies the OCR-pre-filled supplier, invoice number, date, and totals against the PDF.

attributes.label: IRN missing invalid for ITC
attributes.description: An invoice from a supplier required to issue e-invoices that lacks an IRN is not valid for input tax credit.

attributes.label: IRN_MISSING exception meaning
attributes.description: The exception code IRN_MISSING means e-invoice required but absent (referencing section 5.4).

attributes.label: IRN_MISSING exception owner
attributes.description: The owner of the IRN_MISSING exception is the Supplier.

attributes.label: Return invoice if IRN missing
attributes.description: Invoices from suppliers above the turnover threshold must be returned if the IRN is missing.

attributes.label: IRN_MISSING resolution target
attributes.description: The IRN_MISSING exception must be resolved when the e-invoice is received.

attributes.label: ITC claim rule
attributes.description: Input tax credit is claimed only for invoices that appear in the client's GSTR-2B.

attributes.label: Conflict handling rule
attributes.description: A knowledge tool must not give a tax answer with confidence when documents disagree; it must present both versions and indicate which is newer.

attributes.label: Marketing agency missing campaign ID exception
synonyms: marketing agency missing campaign id exception
attributes.description: Marketing agency invoices without a campaign ID are held as NON_PO_NOT_ALLOWED even when a PO exists.

attributes.label: Goods matching type
attributes.description: Goods invoices must be matched three ways: purchase order, goods receipt note, and invoice.

attributes.label: Services matching type
attributes.description: Service invoices must be matched two ways: purchase order and approved service entry sheet.

attributes.label: Match type determined by
attributes.description: The match type is determined by the purchase order, not by the invoice.

attributes.label: Matching method summary
attributes.description: Goods are matched three ways (PO, GRN, invoice) and services are matched two ways.

attributes.label: GSTIN_MISMATCH exception meaning
attributes.description: The meaning of exception code GSTIN_MISMATCH is 'Wrong buyer GSTIN (5.2)'.

attributes.label: Payment terms description
attributes.description: Medium enterprises follow normal payment terms (60 days from invoice acceptance).

attributes.label: Missing GRN escalation days
attributes.description: The system escalates to the requester's manager after five working days for a goods invoice with no GRN; a reminder is sent after two working days.

attributes.label: Missing GRN exception code
attributes.description: A goods invoice with no GRN must be held with exception code NO_GRN.

attributes.label: Late work advice
attributes.description: Staff should not stay late to process invoices after the cutoff.

attributes.label: MSME_DUE flag urgent
attributes.description: Every MSME_DUE flag must be treated as urgent.

attributes.label: Late payment consequences
attributes.description: Late payment to an MSME makes the client liable for compound interest and can disallow the expense for income tax.

attributes.label: AATO band recorded at creation and reviewed annually
attributes.description: The AATO band for the e-invoice check is recorded at supplier creation and reviewed every April.

attributes.label: QRMP flag recorded at creation and reviewed annually
attributes.description: The QRMP filing flag is recorded at supplier creation and reviewed every April.

attributes.label: Required documents for new supplier
attributes.description: A new supplier must be created with PAN, GST registration certificate or declaration of non-registration, cancelled cheque or bank letter, Udyam registration certificate if MSME, and signed Supplier Code of Conduct.

attributes.label: No additional approval threshold
attributes.description: Invoices up to ₹25 lakh require no additional approval.

attributes.label: Budget owner approval required for non-PO invoices
synonyms: non po budget owner approval required
attributes.description: A non-PO invoice of any amount requires the budget owner's approval in the workflow.

attributes.label: Only listed non-PO categories allowed
synonyms: non po only listed categories allowed
attributes.description: Every invoice that is not in the listed non-PO categories requires a purchase order.

attributes.label: Not in GSTR-2B escalation rule
attributes.description: If an invoice is still missing from GSTR-2B after two further GSTR-2B cycles, raise NOT_IN_2B to the vendor relationship owner.

attributes.label: Open GST tab required
attributes.description: The GST tab must be opened.

attributes.label: Open TDS tab for goods invoice
attributes.description: The user must open the TDS tab when posting a goods invoice.

attributes.label: GSTIN_MISMATCH exception owner
attributes.description: The owner of exception code GSTIN_MISMATCH is Supplier.

attributes.label: Paper invoice accepted from
attributes.description: Paper invoices are accepted only from Arvana Infra Projects construction sites.

attributes.label: Paper invoice scanning day
attributes.description: Paper invoices are scanned on the day of receipt.

attributes.label: Paper invoice scanning location
attributes.description: Paper invoices are scanned at the Hyderabad mail room.

attributes.label: Paper invoice scanning SLA
attributes.description: Paper invoices must be scanned within one working day of receipt.

attributes.label: Payment run frequency
attributes.description: Payment runs occur twice weekly.

attributes.label: Payment timing rule
attributes.description: Pay on the last payment run on or before the due date; never pay early without Treasury approval.

attributes.label: Clean invoice posting action
attributes.description: If the invoice is clean, the user clicks Post.

attributes.label: Action on not clean invoice
attributes.description: If the invoice is not clean, the user clicks Park with exception and picks an exception code.

attributes.label: Lower price acceptance
attributes.description: If the invoice price is lower than the PO price, the line is accepted and paid at the invoice price.

attributes.label: PRICE_VAR resolution process
attributes.description: A line that fails the price tolerance check is held with exception PRICE_VAR, sent to the PO buyer, who must either amend the PO or request a credit note from the supplier.

attributes.label: PRICE_VAR exception note guidelines
synonyms: price var exception note bad practice
attributes.description: A bad exception note for price variance is vague and lacks specific details. A good exception note includes line item details, rates, excess amount, quantity, threshold reference, and required resolution action.

attributes.label: PRICE_VAR meaning
attributes.description: PRICE_VAR means unit price above tolerance as per section 4.2.

attributes.label: PRICE_VAR owner
attributes.description: The owner of PRICE_VAR exceptions is the PO buyer.

attributes.label: PRICE_VAR target resolution days
attributes.description: PRICE_VAR exceptions must be resolved within 3 working days.

attributes.label: MSME_DUE priority reason
attributes.description: The senior processor prioritizes the MSME_DUE exception list at the start of the day because it is the only exception that results in a call from the client's CFO.

attributes.label: Supplier upload timing pattern
attributes.description: Small suppliers often upload invoices only at quarter-end unless they use the invoice furnishing facility.

attributes.label: QTY_VAR target resolution days
attributes.description: The target resolution time for exception code QTY_VAR is 3 working days.

attributes.label: Applicability per client memo
attributes.description: Quantity tolerance now only applies as per client memo CM-INF-02.

attributes.label: Question escalation to
attributes.description: Questions about the SOP should be raised with the Team Lead.

attributes.label: Raise QA_RELEASE_PENDING on quarantine or rejected
synonyms: raise qa release pending on quarantine or rejected
attributes.description: For Arvana Pharma, if the batch is in Quarantine or Rejected, the QA_RELEASE_PENDING exception must be raised.

attributes.label: RCM_REVIEW flagging and routing
attributes.description: Services subject to reverse charge are flagged RCM_REVIEW and routed to the Tax Desk before posting.

attributes.label: RCM_REVIEW meaning
attributes.description: The meaning of exception code RCM_REVIEW is Reverse-charge service (5.6).

attributes.label: RCM_REVIEW owner
attributes.description: The owner of exception code RCM_REVIEW is Tax Desk.

attributes.label: RCM_REVIEW target resolution days
attributes.description: The target resolution time for exception code RCM_REVIEW is 2 working days.

attributes.label: Reject plain invoice above threshold
attributes.description: If a supplier with turnover above ten crore sends a plain invoice without IRN, the AP processor must send it back.

attributes.label: Remote site patience advised
attributes.description: AP processors should be patient with remote sites when waiting for GRN posting.

attributes.label: Rent invoice GST exemption if landlord unregistered
synonyms: rent invoice gst if landlord unregistered
attributes.description: Rent invoices may not show GST if the landlord is not registered.

attributes.label: Report tolerance discrepancy
attributes.description: If a tolerance different from the SOP v4.0 rule is observed, the processor must report it to the Team Lead.

attributes.label: Senior processor resolves escalated exceptions
attributes.description: The Senior Processor resolves exceptions that a Processor cannot resolve.

attributes.label: Short invoicing accepted
attributes.description: Short invoicing (invoice quantity below GRN quantity) is accepted, and the balance stays open on the GRN.

attributes.label: Store rent missing fields action
